name: 단속운동 (사카드) 분석
description: Detects unnatural saccadic eye movement patterns — AI videos often lack realistic micro-saccades (Duchowski, 2017).
mechanism:
This method analyzes saccadic eye movements for deepfake detection:

1. **Saccade감지**: Saccades (rapid ballistic eye movements) are detected from the gaze direction temporal signal. Saccades are characterized by their amplitude (typical 1-40°), peak velocity (up to 500°/s), and duration (20-200ms).

2. **MainSequence검증**: Saccades follow the "main sequence" — a fixed relationship between amplitude and peak velocity: V_peak ∝ √amplitude (Bahill et al., 1975). The method checks whether detected saccades conform to this physiological invariant. AI-generated eye movements may violate the main sequence — producing incorrect velocity-amplitude relationships.

3. **SaccadeDynamics분석**: Natural saccades have characteristic dynamics: rapid acceleration, smooth velocity profile with single peak, small post-saccadic oscillation. The method analyzes each saccade's kinematic profile. AI-generated saccades may show: multiple velocity peaks, incorrect acceleration/deceleration asymmetry, or missing post-saccadic ringing.

4. **Fixation-Saccade패턴**: Natural gaze alternates between fixations (~200-400ms, stable gaze) and saccades (~20-80ms, rapid shifts). The method verifies this pattern — particularly the fixation duration distribution (approximately log-normal) and saccade rate (3-4 per second during reading/scanning). Deepfakes may show anomalous fixation-saccade patterns.

5. **BilateralSaccadeCoordination**: Both eyes execute saccades simultaneously (conjugate movements). The method checks saccade synchrony between eyes — independent AI generation of each eye may produce asynchronous or differently-sized saccades between left and right eyes.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
